links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified online pediatric cataract PEMs retrieved from Google
links.outcome: Readability (reading grade level) of patient education materials
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1 reduced reading level from 10.59 ± 2.20 to 7.01 ± 0.91 (P < 0.001); original Google PEMs showed significantly improved readability after LLM conversion
links.quote: Original PEMs from Google showed significantly improved readability after LLM conversion, with DeepSeek-R1 achieving the greatest reduction in reading level from 10.59 ± 2.20 to 7.01 ± 0.91 (P < 0.001).
